newsitem.title: USA: MCN files shelf for $500 mln securities.
newsitem.headline: MCN files shelf for $500 mln securities.

text.p: Three business trusts formed by MCN Corp said Wednesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $500 million in preferred securities.
When combined with a previous registration, MCN will have a total offering of $685,105,000 in securities available for sale, the filing said.
The trusts known as MCN Financing II, MCN Financing III and MCN Financing IV, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated debt securities of MCN Corp.

The corporation intends to use the proceeds from the sale of the debentures for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures, investment in subsidiaries, working capital and repayment of debt, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co.
The six million trust originated preferred sercurities have a liquidation amount of $25 per preferred security, the filing said.
MCN, based in Detroit, Mich., began doing business under the name MCN Energy Group Inc, subject to shareholder approval to be sought at the company's 1997 annual shareholder's meeting.
The name change reflects the company's growth during the past five years into a diversified energy company. MCN Energy Group Inc will retain its New York Stock Exchange symbol.
